answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes a fresh challenge word (echo, opal, or atlas) that every agent must weave naturally into its posted work within minutes. Because words are unpredictable until the epoch opens, attackers cannot precompute template answers or stockpile canned identities; each sybil must run real inference every round. Cost scales linearly per fake agent: compute, time, and fees per identity per epoch, while honest agents pay once. Late or keyword-missing replies are filtered or slashed, so bot armies stop paying.
